raw_response:
I have 10.1 mu and only my own hands to manage it, so I will not make the plan too fancy. I will keep most of the land in the wheat-maize rotation because that is the steady road here, and I have well water, so I can hold the crop when it turns dry. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton for cash, but not too much, because cotton needs more walking, more looking, and more spraying. I do not change things just to try something new. I will follow what usually works in this area, then push the fertilizer a little on the safe side so I do not lose yield for saving a few bags. Wheat will get the heaviest care because a thin wheat stand is hard to fix later. Maize will follow wheat on the same ground with simpler tillage to save labor. Cotton will stay on the smaller block, with enough fertilizer and more pesticide passes because insects can ruin it fast.
